conviction_note: Confirmed the event and rebuilt the real history (Feb-25 -49% on guidance suspension, Jun-2 -30% on a Q1 miss plus a -25/-30% Q2 guide); the only non-wire evidence I could get is that IL MAKIAGE's own paid-acquisition funnel kept shrinking through June, July and August while sister brand SpoiledChild grew, which argues against the H2-normalisation story the +44%-off-the-low price and the -16 vol-point call bid are paying for -- but the bar is low (consensus $178.2M sits at the TOP of the company's own $168.8-180.9M guide, average PT $11.07 is BELOW spot $13.33) and 23% of a 28M float is short with 6-9 days to cover, so the upside tail is real and I size the net at roughly a sixth of the 20.7% implied move.

findings.finding: IL MAKIAGE's own web traffic -- whose single largest channel is Display advertising at 28.84% of desktop visits, i.e. a direct read on the paid-acquisition funnel management says it is re-scaling -- kept falling sequentially all summer: 2.44M visits in June 2026, 2.36M in July (-3.18%), ~2.3M in August (-4.73%), with the site's global rank sliding from ~10,747 to ~15,447 over three months.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-08 (page states: 'In July ilmakiage.com received 2.36M visits', down 3.18% from June's 2.44M)
findings.why_not_priced: The entire bull case for the +44% move off the $9.25 low rests on one company-supplied datapoint from the 2026-06-02 call: a 28% sequential drop in IL MAKIAGE CPA from April to May, and a stated intention to keep spending to recalibrate the algorithm. Nobody aggregates brand-level traffic for ODD, there is no sell-side note or wire story on it, and if the market had checked it the coverage would not read 'Makes Progress Toward Normalization' and the 25-delta skew would not be -16 vol points bid for calls. Re-scaled acquisition spend produces rising sessions; sessions fell in each of the three months after the guide was given.
findings.independence: Same-vendor family but a DIFFERENT property and a different month, acting as a seasonality control: spoiledchild.com traffic rose 3.95% month-over-month in August 2026 while ilmakiage.com fell 4.73% in the same month, so the IL MAKIAGE erosion is brand-specific rather than the summer beauty-DTC trough -- and IL MAKIAGE is precisely the brand management identified as the one hit by the ad-platform dislocation. https://www.similarweb.com/website/spoiledchild.com/ and https://www.similarweb.com/website/ilmakiage.com/ (both August 2026 data)

findings.finding: Short interest is 6.58M shares, ~23% of a 28.1M share float with 6-9 days to cover, and it ROSE from ~6.00M a month earlier -- shorts added into the rally and into the print; the most parsimonious reading of the baseline's -16.19 vol-point 25-delta skew is a crowded short book buying OTM calls as gap protection, not the market making a bullish statement.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-08 (page shows short interest 6.58M, 23.04% of float, short ratio 8.96, dated September 8, 2026, 'increased from 6.00 million shares the previous month')
findings.why_not_priced: Two things are visibly mis-set. First, the current wire copy on ODD short interest is stale: the marketbeat item search engines surface for 'ODD short interest' is at URL path /2025/09/ and quotes 6.32M falling to 4.76M and 15.4% of shares -- an August 2025 series being served as current, so the published number understates both the level and the direction. Second, if the -16.19 skew were a genuine directional market view rather than short-book hedging, you would not simultaneously see a 24,001-lot deep-OTM put print and a sell-side average target 17% below spot. The practical consequence is asymmetry, not direction: with 6-9 days to cover, any in-line-or-better Q2 against a guide the company set three months ago under near-zero visibility gets amplified upward.
findings.independence: Different source, different instrument, and it points the opposite way to the skew: on 2026-09-02/03 a single trade of 24,001 October $7.50 puts printed -- 99.9% of the day's option volume and ~2.8x that strike's existing open interest -- with the stock at $14.54, i.e. real money paying for a sub-$7.50 tail. Note this is a second reading of the SAME options market as the skew figure in my finding, so treat the options evidence as one cluster. https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/oddity-tech-options-flow-signals-defensive-positioning-ahead-of-september-earnings-93CH-4888226 (2026-09-03)

findings.finding: A 6-K filed 2026-06-12 discloses that on 2026-06-11 Oddity Finance LLC privately agreed to repurchase $50M face of its 0% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2030 for $35M cash, closing 2026-06-17 and leaving $550M outstanding -- roughly a $15M pre-tax gain on extinguishment that lands in Q2 GAAP results and is not in the $0.1223 adjusted consensus, and it prices the company's own paper at ~70 cents in June.
findings.why_not_priced: Only TipRanks and GuruFocus picked this up; it did not reach the mainstream wire or any earnings preview I could find, and the one estimate on the calendar is an adjusted number that by construction excludes the gain. Its bigger use is as a read on management intent: with ~$632M of cash and investments post-transaction, $167M left on the $200M share authorisation as of 2026-03-31, and both its equity and its own bonds trading distressed, a fresh or upsized capital-return announcement alongside the print is a live positive tail that no preview I found flags. If this were priced, previews would be discussing GAAP-vs-adjusted for Q2 and the buyback runway rather than only the -25/-30% revenue guide.
findings.independence: https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/oddity-tech-to-repurchase-50-million-of-exchangeable-notes-at-discount -- confirms the same transaction from a non-EDGAR source, which is also the evidence that coverage was thin. The Q1 release's $667.4M cash/investments and $167M remaining authorisation come from the company's own 2026-06-02 exhibit: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907085/000110465926069208/tm2615689d1_ex99-1.htm

Israeli press (Calcalist, CTech, Globes, Bizportal, sponser.co.il) for layoffs or a restructuring at ODDITY/IL MAKIAGE since 2026-06-02 -- nothing; the only short-seller story (Ningi Research) is at a 2024 URL and is long priced
App Store / Google Play rank and review-velocity for the SpoiledChild and IL MAKIAGE apps -- no free source returned rank or review-count time series

A company update between 2026-06-02 and today: the only 6-Ks are the note repurchase (06-12), the AGM proxy (06-16), the AGM results (07-30) and a new independent director, David S. Cohen, ex-Morgan Stanley IM (08-21). No pre-announcement, no interim CPA update, no conference appearance

Insider signal: the only Form 4 activity into the print is CFO Lindsay Drucker Mann's cashless option exercises and sales on 09-01 and 09-03 at $15.09 and $15.01 under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-03-13 -- pre-set, mechanical, no information (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907085/000110465926105163/xslF345X06/tm2624800-1_4seq1.xml)

Apparent share-count collapse (Finviz/StockAnalysis show 45.1M vs 56.3M diluted in Q1) -- a false lead I killed: 45,109,685 is Class A only, plus 11,547,000 Class B as of 2026-03-04 per the FY2025 20-F, so there has been no giant Q2 buyback and the quoted $612M market cap understates the real ~$755M

The Q3 seasonal EBITDA problem (Q3 2025 was only $147.9M revenue at $17.4M operating income, so -25% puts Q3 2026 near $111M with likely negative adjusted EBITDA against a full-year positive-adjusted-EBITDA commitment) -- real, but pure arithmetic off wire data that every model has, and it is already reflected in the $11.07 average price target sitting below spot
Any new retail/wholesale channel (Amazon, Sephora, TikTok Shop) for IL MAKIAGE that would change the acquisition-cost dependency -- no announcement found
baseline_tension: My main finding cuts directly against the baseline's -16.19 vol-point skew and against the +44% rally off the $9.25 low, because it says the paid funnel that the H2-normalisation story depends on was still shrinking in June, July and August; the reconciliation I offer is that the call bid is a hedging artifact of a 23%-of-float short book that grew into the print, not a bullish market view -- but I keep the net at only -3.5 against a 20.7% implied move because the revenue bar is genuinely low (consensus sits at the top of the company's own guide, average target below spot) and a short book that size makes any beat violent to the upside.
